title: 毎日杯の後に・行雲流水

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she raced, Yaeno Muteki became aware of the stark contrast between her own running style and Oguri Cap's relaxed gait.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may have lost, but she says she's more satisfied with her performance today than at her debut race. Our next stop is the first race in the Classic Triple Crown tour, the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, her classmate and rival Mejiro Ardan has to sit out the Satsuki Sho. It seems like her legs are in poor condition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While it's an unfortunate turn of events, it doesn't change Yaeno Muteki's ambition. She declares Sakura Chiyono O her rival and vows to defeat her.
